item.title: Defense attorneys for Palisades Fire suspect seek release, cite new evidence of LAFD failures
item.description: Defense attorneys for the man accused of sparking the deadly Palisades Fire said Thursday that new evidence — including conflicting firefighter testimony about whether hot spots were fully extinguished before the blaze reignited — undermines the federal case against their client and called for his immediate release from custody.Jonathan

item.title: Homeless Services Leader to Complete 50th Marathon in 90 Days at LA Marathon
item.description: Hope the Mission president Rowan Vansleve completes his 50th marathon in 90 days at Sunday's LA Marathon, raising $115,000 for homelessness services.

item.title: Federal safety board releases preliminary findings in Waymo-student collision near elementary school
item.description: NTSB releases preliminary findings on January collision between Waymo autonomous vehicle and 9-year-old student near Santa Monica elementary school.

item.title: TrueCar Cuts 30% of Workforce in Major Restructuring Following Return to Private Ownership
item.description: TrueCar, the Santa Monica-based automotive marketplace, laid off 30% of its workforce (under 100 employees) following its return to private ownership in January 2024.
